sanskrit_verse:
ऊनाधिकं पूर्वपक्षे तावद् वादी विशोधयेत् /
न दद्याद् उत्तरं यावत् प्रत्यर्थी सभ्यसंनिधौ //
transliteration: ūnādhikaṃ pūrvapakṣe tāvad vādī viśodhayet / na dadyād uttaraṃ yāvat pratyarthī sabhyasaṃnidhau //
sph_interpretive_translation: In the event of a deficit or surplus in the initial claim, the petitioner shall rectify such discrepancy prior to the adversary presenting a response within the assembly of qualified witnesses.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the correctness of presentation before judgment
Causation is established through clarity and completeness at inception
Capacity-based responsibility requires correction before counter-response
Restoration logic demands integrity of initial assertion
Consciousness alignment occurs when factual presentation precedes rebuttal
executable_legal_axioms: IF initial claim has deficit OR surplus THEN halt procedural advancement UNTIL petitioner corrects discrepancy
IF pratyarthī (respondent) requests rebuttal THEN ensure vādī (petitioner) has submitted complete and balanced claim FOR review by sabhyasaṃnidhau (qualified witness assembly)
IF claim integrity is compromised THEN disallow progression to argument phase AND mandate recalibration
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, any pleading found deficient or excessive must be corrected in full view of judicial record keepers prior to allowing adversarial engagement, ensuring that truth-in-process aligns with Dharma rather than rhetoric.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality necessitates that error be resolved at its point of origin; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential clarity; proportional responsibility lies in rectifying imbalance without inflicting consequence; non-punitive reality rule confirms that misalignment is corrected through conscious realignment alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Petitioner must fully reconcile numerical or qualitative discrepancies before proceeding
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Claimant acknowledges and resolves inconsistencies voluntarily
Integrity Reintegration: Witness panel verifies recalibrated submission for authenticity
Capacity Restoration: Legal support provided to enable accurate reformulation
final_declaration: This directive originates solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism. Dharma stands restored through conscious rectification, not punitive enforcement. Reality adjudicates through clarity, not condemnation.
